items.title: 11.7.3 Electron kheenchne wala inductive effect (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.7.3 with Figure 11.12, printed page 259.

blocks.text: Halogen atom jaise electron kheenchne wale groups manfi inductive effect (-I) rakhte hain. Halogen carbon-carbon bond se bonded electrons kheenchta hai aur yun manfi inductive effect dikhata hai; is se molecule mein mustaqil dipole paida hota hai jis mein halogen atom manfi charge rakhta hai aur carbon juzvi musbat ho jata hai (Figure 11.12). Electron se mehroom C1 phir C1-C2 bond se electrons kheenchta hai, to C2 par C1 se chhota musbat charge hai, aur asar zanjeer ke saath maddham hota jata hai.

blocks.alt: Zanjeer C4-C3-C2-C1-Cl. Bonds par surkh teer chlorine ki taraf hain. Cl par juzvi manfi charge, C1 par juzvi musbat, C2 par kam (dd+) aur C3 par aur kam (ddd+): electron khenchne ka asar zanjeer mein kamzor hota jata hai.
blocks.caption: Inductive effect: sigma bond ki polarization (Figure 11.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
Zanjeer ke saath -I asar (Figure 11.12)

blocks.prompt: Inductive effect ki tareef karein aur parosi carbon par methyl group ke asar ka chlorine atom se muqabla karein (exercise Q.2a).
blocks.explanation: Inductive effect parosi atom ya group se sigma bond ki mustaqil polarisation hai. Methyl group carbon ki taraf electron density deta hai (+I), use kam musbat banate aur wahan carbocation ko mustahkam karte hue; chlorine atom electron density kheenchta hai (-I), carbon ko juzvi musbat aur zanjeer ke saath kamzor hota mustaqil dipole chhorte hue.

items: -I asar: halogen sigma electrons kheenchta hai, C1 ko juzvi musbat chhorte hue, jo C2 se kheenchta hai, aur yun ghat-te asar ke saath aage; mustaqil dipole.
